market_name: U.S. agrees to a new trade deal with "South Korea" before 2027?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check EWY pre/post-market tick and whether any Reuters/Bloomberg trade-talk headline coincides with the Polymarket move.
time_plan.1h: Compare EWY move to broad EM (EEM) and Asia proxies to isolate Korea-specific vs beta.
time_plan.2h: Monitor USD/KRW and KOSPI futures for confirmation of a genuine Korea-specific catalyst.
time_plan.6h: Reassess whether news has become public; if no credible report emerges, fade the signal as noise.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether EWY held any gain into US close; log realized move vs predicted and note if driven by trade headlines.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a new US-Korea trade agreement becoming law signals reduced tariff/trade friction risk for Korea's heavily export-dependent economy (autos, semis, steel). That is a tailwind for Korean large-caps captured by EWY. However, a bilateral trade law affects earnings over quarters/years, not hours, so any 12h repricing would be modest and sentiment-driven rather than a step-change.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: US Dollar / Korean Won spot (won appreciation)

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check USD/KRW spot direction and whether DXY is driving it rather than Korea-specific flow.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check with other Asia FX (TWD, JPY) to separate broad dollar from Korea idiosyncratic move.
time_plan.2h: Look for official statements from USTR or Korean trade ministry.
time_plan.6h: Reassess if the probability move persists or reverses; fade if no public confirmation.
time_plan.12h: Log realized USD/KRW change vs prediction and attribute to trade news vs macro.

predictions.reasoning: An improved trade outlook typically supports the won via stronger expected export flows and risk-on sentiment toward Korean assets. 'Up' here denotes won appreciation (USD/KRW lower). FX reaction to a probability shift on a multi-year legislative event is small and easily swamped by DXY and global risk moves, so confidence and magnitude are low.

evidence_used: Market question: new US-South Korea trade deal becoming law by end-2026
Resolution requires US legal enactment (ratification or Congressional-Executive Agreement)
South Korea is a highly export-dependent economy; EWY and KRW are the most liquid Korea-specific proxies
A US-Korea FTA (KORUS) already exists and was renegotiated in 2018, limiting incremental impact of a 'new' deal
uncertainty_notes: Legislative trade outcomes play out over years; a 12h window captures mostly sentiment, not fundamentals
The 700bps tradable threshold is far above any plausible 12h move for these liquid, diversified proxies
Korea already has KORUS, so a 'new deal' may be incremental and ambiguously defined, muting asset response

llm_justification.summary: A sharp rise in the implied probability of a new US-South Korea trade agreement becoming law would modestly favor Korean equities (EWY) and the Korean won (USD/KRW lower) via reduced trade friction and improved export outlook. But because the event is a multi-year legislative matter and an FTA already exists, any 12-hour repricing is small and sentiment-driven — well below the 700bps tradable bar. Treat as a weak, low-confidence signal.
key_assumptions: A probability move reflects genuine new information about trade-deal progress, not noise
EWY and KRW are the cleanest liquid proxies for Korea-specific trade news
Trade de-escalation is net positive for Korean export-linked assets
failure_modes: Move is noise/low-liquidity on Polymarket with no real catalyst
Information already public and priced, so no asset follow-through
KORUS already exists; a 'new deal' adds little, weakening the EWY/KRW linkage
Broad dollar or global risk sentiment dominates Korea-specific FX/equity moves
12h magnitude far below 700bps, so neither prediction is tradable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
